requirements: R1: Fix execution permissions for backup.sh so the backup service starts correctly and the environment passes health checks

slices.title: Fix backup.sh execution permissions
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to ensure the backup script is executable, so that the environment initializes successfully without permission errors.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application is started via docker-compose,
When the backup service executes backup.sh,
Then it executes successfully without a 'Permission denied' error and the application passes health checks.
